name: Add-in Release Gate
description: Validate, build, package and check an add-in before submission.
trigger: A product is ready for submission, or a release branch is cut.
acceptanceTest: Every declared version in the matrix produced an installer.
The validation report lists zero blocking findings.
The privacy-policy URL in the manifest resolves with a 200.

writes.blastRadius: Overwrites build output. Reversible by rebuilding.
Writes installer, bundle and one audit record.
